lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is a joint HARC and P&Z special meeting Monday to work through Land Use Code and Design Guideline amendments required for Telluride's compliance with the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — whatever they recommend goes straight to Town Council for the final call, so this is a real step forward on something that's been coming for a while. Thursday, the Telluride Hospital District board takes up mill levy considerations, and P&Z holds a work session on the Shandoka Lot redevelopment. Plenty happening around town too, from the Yoga Festival to the Oak Street Park SummerSHOW series kicking off Thursday.

notable.stake: Recommended Land Use Code changes for wildfire code compliance head to Town Council.
Mill levy discussion directly affects how the hospital district is funded by taxpayers.
Major Town-owned redevelopment project gets its first substantive commission review.
